free_text.text: Main analysis files traced: 3_1 (DID/event-study), 5_1 (ETI/IV). Two primary designs identified.

Main analysis pipeline traced: master→build→lasso→instrument→analysis. Primary focus on IV design with shift-share instrument (GM_hat2). Shift-share construction uses 1935-1940 Black migrant location shares interacted with LASSO-predicted county-level out-migration 1940-1970. Main tables and figures identified; appendix tables omitted. Standard error specification not explicitly documented in main scripts.
Full sample of cases arraigned in lower court

Main replication script covers empirical application in NYC. Test implementation in testjfe.ado and testjfe.m performs semiparametric test for exclusion/monotonicity assumptions. Simulations compare test to Kitagawa alternatives. Multiple simulation scripts present; empirical analysis is primary focus.
drop if mi(minadrdyear); drop if num_blyear != 1
drop if minhoscyear < minadrdyear

Main analysis uses IV regression (2SLS with distance instrument), Mountjoy three-way IV, and distributed lags event study. No staggered DID with csdid found in analysis code despite package installation.
Scripts numbered 1-3 for data pipeline, table*.do for output
use final_24after_3mon.dta, 24-month observation period
Main analysis: IV estimation with post-LASSO covariate selection on nested samples (full → treated → drug-treated)
Judge assignment is quasi-random source of exogenous variation
Judge removal tendency (jscore) is the instrument
Complier analysis with reweighting by risk stratification
Judge assignment is as-good-as-random within court-year-case
Global macro system for sample, FE, and control sets: $controls, $FE, $clusterop, $SAMP define all model components
Stored model naming: est store m1/m2/m3 by outcome
Drop judges with fewer than 25 cases
Exclude court-year cells with fewer than 2 judges
Exclude appeals (only first-instance cases)
Complete read of master, all cleaning scripts, complier weighting logic, and main analysis specifications for mortality tables. All estimation commands and sample definitions traced.
Restrict to year==1900 for main cross-sectional analysis in Table 2
Restrict to non-South counties (North==0) for Table 3 multicohort analysis

Article focuses on Confederate diaspora migration flows and cultural transmission. Master script (0_master-results.do) orchestrates data construction and analysis. Main analysis scripts (3_table2.do, 3_table3.do, etc.) use reghdfe for OLS and ivreghdfe for IV specifications. Custom ado files implement bias-corrected TSLS and spatial HAC standard errors. Server-only files handle restricted datasets (slave schedule, KKK rosters) and large-scale data merging; these prevent complete specification en
Master.R, 13 applications, saturated specs
Two-step estimation: first-step ordered probit on adoption choices; second-step nested fixed point
Value function iteration using transition matrix contraction (I - beta*P)^{-1}
Bootstrap procedure (500 replicates) for standard errors
Counterfactual simulations: social planner coordination benchmark, targeted and blanket subsidies

Two-stage structural estimation of dynamic discrete choice game. First stage: ordered probit on adoption decisions (mle2). Second stage: nested fixed point with value function iteration over transition matrices. Counterfactual analyses solve social planner and subsidy scenarios. Bootstrap procedure for SE. Repository lacks README and explicit entry point; execution order inferred from section comments.
Global macros for paths: ROOT, ADO, data, output

Main IV specifications in replication_tables.do lines 442-443 (twostepweakiv) and 466 (ivreg2). Two-treatment design with weak-IV robust inference via twostepweakiv (LC confidence sets, AR and K tests). Complementary survey analysis in R (lm_robust with wave FE). Data preparation in R sources helper scripts for outcome construction.
